remarks: The one you've been waiting for! Rarely does a home offer the character of an established neighborhood with the quality and convenience of essentially brand-new construction. Completely renovated from top to bottom, this turnkey 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is perfect as a starter home, condo alternative, or right-sizing opportunity. Every detail from the designer kitchen and luxurious baths to the roof, windows, siding, and major mechanical systems has been replaced or upgraded, creating a home designed for effortless living. The inviting open floor plan seamlessly blends comfort and functionality. The professionally landscaped grounds and an oversized entertaining deck provide the perfect backdrop for summer gatherings, outdoor dining, and everyday enjoyment. Just moments from Darien's award-winning schools, Metro-North, Rowayton Village, Five Mile River, beaches, shops, and restaurants, this home is perfectly positioned to enjoy an effortless coastal lifestyle. Simply unpack and enjoy summer just minutes from the water.
